name: chat-room
description: Local chat rooms, presence, worktree channels, and explicit idle-session wakeups for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: A local chat room for humans, agents, and Git worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Gives every Git project a local, advisory chat room shared by humans, Codex sessions, Claude Code sessions, subagents, and linked worktrees. Active sessions receive @handles, worktrees become #targets, lifecycle hooks deliver context, and Codex sessions launched through Chat Room can start a turn when explicitly tagged while idle.
defaultPrompt: List active agent handles and linked worktrees.
